title: Sohar Health CEO on KevinMD: How to Fix U.S. Health Care Pricing Confusion
summary: On KevinMD, our CEO highlights how opaque pricing, misaligned incentives, and weak enforcement contribute to rising healthcare costs—and outlines solutions rooted in technology, transparency, and accountability.
body_markdown:
In this KevinMD op‑ed, Sohar Health’s leadership explores why healthcare pricing in the U.S. remains so inconsistent and confusing for patients. The piece argues that combined efforts in policy reform, better data access, and digital tools are key to restoring transparency and consumer trust.


‍
Link to the full article available[here](https://kevinmd.com/2025/06/why-u-s-health-care-pricing-is-so-confusing-and-how-to-fix-it.html) .
